sentiment.reason_it: Il sentiment di mercato è positivo oggi, con S&P 500 in aumento del 0.50% e VIX in calo del 5.77%. L'accordo tra USA e Iran ha ridotto le tensioni geopolitiche, favorendo gli asset rischiosi. Il rapporto di Goldman Sachs sull'economia spagnola, che cresce tre volte più velocemente dell'area euro, contribuisce al sentiment positivo. BlackRock Investment Institute segnala una riduzione delle emissioni di carbonio nei portafogli della BCE.
sentiment.reason_en: Market sentiment is positive today, with S&P 500 up 0.50% and VIX down 5.77%. The US-Iran agreement has reduced geopolitical tensions, favoring risk assets. Goldman Sachs' report on Spain's economy growing three times faster than the euro area adds to the positive sentiment. BlackRock Investment Institute reports a decline in carbon emissions in ECB portfolios.

market_impact_summary.it: L'accordo tra USA e Iran ha fatto scendere il prezzo del petrolio del 5.00%, mentre l'S&P 500 è salito dello 0.50%. Il DXY è sceso del 0.22% e l'oro è salito del 3.40%. I tassi dei bond USA a 10 anni sono saliti dello 0.54%.
market_impact_summary.en: The US-Iran agreement led to a 5.00% drop in oil prices, while S&P 500 rose 0.50%. DXY fell 0.22% and gold rose 3.40%. US 10-year bond yields increased by 0.54%.

audio_script_it:
Buongiorno, benvenuti al Morning Briefing di Price Alert.

Il Nikkei ha chiuso in rialzo del 4.99%, Shanghai in rialzo dell'1.61%. Questo suggerisce un'apertura positiva per i mercati europei.

L'S&P 500 ha chiuso in rialzo dello 0.5%, il VIX è in calo del 5.77%. L'oro è in rialzo del 3.4% a $4358.4/oz, il petrolio in calo del 5% a $82.96 Il rendimento del decennale americano è in rialzo dello 0.54% al 4.48%, il Dollar Index in calo dello 0.22% a 99.53 Lo STOXX 600 ha chiuso in calo dello 0.42%.

L'accordo tra USA e Iran ha fatto scendere il petrolio e il gas. Le Borse hanno reagito positivamente a questo sviluppo.

Nessun dato macro rilevante in uscita oggi.

Passiamo ora al comparto degli asset digitali. Bitcoin si apprezza del 2,46%, raggiungendo i sessantaseimila dollari e centosessantadue. I flussi ETF giornalieri mostrano un afflusso netto di 85,9 milioni di dollari. Questo movimento potrebbe essere influenzato da una generale ripresa dei mercati finanziari. 
  Tra le altcoin, Ethereum guadagna il 5,07%, arrivando a mille settecentosessanta dollari. Solana registra un aumento del 6,43%, quotandosi a settantadue virgola cinquanta sei dollari. BNB cresce dell'1,39%, raggiungendo i seicentoventi dollari e ottantotto centesimi. 
  Il Fear & Greed Index scende a 20, classificandosi come Extreme Fear. Questo livello suggerisce cautela tra gli investitori.

Nessun dato macro in agenda oggi. Per approfondire i temi di oggi, sulla nostra piattaforma trovate gli articoli completi nella sezione Storie in Primo Piano. Grazie per l'attenzione e a domani.
audio_script_en: Good morning, welcome to the Price Alert Morning Briefing. The Nikkei closed up 4.99%, Shanghai up 1.61%. This suggests a positive opening for European markets. The S&P 500 closed up 0.5%, the VIX is down 5.77%. Gold is up 3.4% at $4358.4/oz, oil down 5% at $82.96 The 10-year US yield is up 0.54% to 4.48%, the Dollar Index down 0.22% at 99.53 The STOXX 600 closed down 0.42%. The agreement between the US and Iran led to a drop in oil and gas prices. Stock exchanges reacted positively to this development. No major macroeconomic data releases today. Let's pivot to the cryptocurrency markets... Bitcoin appreciates 2.46%, reaching $66,162 Daily ETF flows show a net inflow of $85.49 million. This movement could be influenced by a general recovery in financial markets. Among altcoins, Ethereum gains 5.07%, reaching $1,760 Solana registers an increase of 6.43%, quoting at $72.56 BNB grows 1.39%, reaching $620.88 The Fear & Greed Index drops to 20, classified as Extreme Fear. This level suggests caution among investors. No macroeconomic data on the agenda today. For a deeper dive into today's topics, find the full articles in the Top Stories section on our platform. Thanks for your attention, and we'll see you tomorrow.

articles.snippet: As it faces the exigencies of an existential war, Ukraine is confronted with stark fiscal and financial policy trade-offs, despite the mitigation provided by large-scale external financial support. articles.title: No Bridge Over Healing Waters for the G7
articles.snippet: The French G7 presidency’s focus on global imbalances is both welcome and problematic. While long-standing trade imbalances between the United States, Europe, and China are, if anything, becoming even more troublesome, the leaders’ summit in Évian-les-Bains will do nothing to address the problem.

articles.title: How Japan Could Co-Produce the Navy’s Future Fleet
articles.snippet: America’s defense industrial base cannot build the Navy out of the threat it faces. Decades of industry consolidation, persistent resource shortages, and inconsistent demand signals have delayed the production of critical vessels and munitions. With production bottlenecks stacking up, the Navy may have no choice but to let its allies do some of the building.Both the National Defense Strategy and Navy Warfighting Instructions highlight how mobilizing allies can field more forces to the mutual benefit of the United States and its strategic partners. Likewise, the latest U.S. Navy Shipbuilding Plan stresses the importance of allied investment and production.The Trump administration The post How Japan Could Co-Produce the Navy’s Future Fleet appeared first on War on the Rocks .

articles.title: U.S.-Iran Deal Doesn’t Mean a Swift Return of Oil and Gas Flows
articles.snippet: The U.S.-Iran deal and the potentially imminent reopening of the Strait of Hormuz do not mean that oil and gas trade will quickly return to its previous levels. The announcement of the deal is just the first step, and it could take months for oil and gas shipments in the region to return to pre-war levels. Middle Eastern producers have been forced to shut in more than 10 million barrels per day of oil production since the Strait of Hormuz was closed three and a half months ago. Producers will need months to fully ramp up wells to previous output…
